· TheC64 Mini + Maxi compatible

424127.overview:
Rogue64 is a dungeon explorer game (roguelike) with procedurally generated levels. It plays in a 10x10 tile map and has 8 levels.

You play as "Zendar the explorer" and search for treasures in chests and for a magical item that is rumoured to be at the bottom of "The Dungeons of Mordecoom". As you descend, the monsters get tougher and tougher. After killing several monsters, you can pick up a gem which will give you more strength and health. In order to advance to the next level, you need to find a key in the current level.

Enemies are called Gluthulhu, Skorpeeo, Batty, Snark and Hornzilla. Ghosts and other monsters can also be found. Hearts can be collected to restore your full health. You can also find green, red and blue potions. Green potions always restore your health, red and blue potion effects are randomized each game. Possible effects include time freeze, map reveal, kill all monsters in the room and getting drunk.

424338.overview: Guide RodMän around the maze, collecting the round purple things. Also collect the yellow diamonds because they're bombs and can be used to blow up RodMän's enemies. When moving around, avoid the things which are also moving around, as they aren't very nice. Apparently, the things that move are called ● Naughtly Nic ● Dirty Tim ● Desperate Dave ● Spurious Pete ● Teflon Timmy Although no one knows why. There are three levels, and each level has three screens: ● Garden ● House ● Basement Giving a total of nine unique screens.

425168.overview: In the early sixties, NASA scientists detected a strange celestial body, that was slowly heading towards Earth, and the calculated a certain impact 60 years into their future.  Based on intercepted radio transmissions from this asteroid-like body, they determined, that it was purposely guided.  To avoid global panic, they decided to keep this find secret but to send an armed robot to intercept the body and exterminate the evil entities on board, smirkingly called the seven wizards.

425263.overview: Riviera Story by Bladawietz is an arcade platformer in which you play as Fred and must survive deadly trials by avoiding enemies, collecting beer and replenishing your supply in the allotted time.

425433.overview: Robin Hood's Gold is a single player logical brain/puzzle game for the Commodore 64. It was developed by Barbara H. Schulak and published in Loadstar #060.

425461.overview: An unfinished preview/demo version of a vertically scrolling shooter developed by Tom Otzelberger using Chris Yate's SEUCK engine. This unfinished game was released into the public domain in 1989.

425514.overview: An early game preview, a mix of space taxi and Thrust. Maneuver your ship to gather those needing rescuing from the harsh alien landscape. If you can safely get all of them, you move to the next level. If you cannot, if you hit a rocky outcropping, you must start over on that level. You only have a handful of ships to be a Rescuer.

425524.overview: A catch it game based on the old Nintendo Game and Watch game, Fire. Developed by Syed Umer Rizvi and Richard Bayliss, and released by Reset64 Magazine in 2020.

444258.overview: Rotor Rampage is a helicopter-themed arcade game where your objective is to steer your chopper through a labyrinthine complex, rescuing a specific number of trapped people. To do this, you will have to evade alien enemies, missile rockets, and other hazards, all while managing your limited ammo and fuel supply, both of which can be replenished by landing on designated areas within the game world. Large parts of the game world can be shot at or bombed, allowing closed-off sections to be opened up. The game also contains hidden switches that you need to either shoot or fly over to unlock hidden doors. Rotor Rampage comes in two versions - Lite (core level plus 5 more) and Full (core level plus 10 more). Each of the levels on offer has its own distinct graphical theme.

448591.overview:
Cops and Robbers is a two-player game originally published in "The Commodore 64 Games Book - 21 Sensational Games." One player controls the cops, while the other controls the robbers. The goal for the cops is to chase and catch the robbers in the city before they escape to their hideout.

The city streets run north to south and east to west. The cops have faster cars but must obey traffic laws, allowing only forward or left turns at intersections, with no right turns or U-turns. The robbers can ignore traffic laws, giving them better maneuverability despite having slower cars.

Players can choose the speed of the game. At its fastest, it becomes a thrilling chase through the streets. Played more slowly, it becomes a game of strategy.

448623.overview:
RandomPac is a tribute to Pac-Man (Pakkuman), an arcade game released by Namco in 1980.

Main differences from the original version:

Procedurally generated mazes
Bonus rounds
Gameplay
RandomPac is an action maze chase video game; the player controls Pac-Man through an enclosed maze. The objective of the game is to eat all of the dots placed in the maze while avoiding four colored ghosts - Blinky (red), Pinky (pink), Inky (cyan), and Clyde (orange) - who pursue Pac-Man. When Pac-Man eats all of the dots, the player advances to the next round. Rounds are indicated by fruit icons at the bottom of the screen. After the first 2 rounds and every 3 rounds thereafter, Pac-Man enters a bonus round where he has to eat all the bonus items before the time runs out.

If Pac-Man is caught by a ghost, he will lose a life; the game ends when all lives are lost.

Placed near the four corners of the maze are large flashing "energizers" or "power pellets." When Pac-Man eats one, the ghosts turn blue with a dizzied expression and reverse direction. Pac-Man can eat blue ghosts for bonus points; when a ghost is eaten, its eyes make their way back to the center box in the maze, where the ghost "regenerates" and resumes its normal activity. Eating multiple blue ghosts in succession increases their point value. After a certain amount of time, blue-colored ghosts will flash white before turning back into their normal forms.

Eating a certain number of dots in a round will cause a bonus item - usually a fruit - to appear underneath the center box; the item can be eaten for bonus points.

To the sides of the maze are two "warp tunnels", which allow Pac-Man and the ghosts to travel to the opposite side of the screen. Ghosts become slower when entering and exiting these tunnels.

The game increases in difficulty as the player progresses through the rounds: the ghosts become faster, and the energizers' effect decreases in duration.

At 10000 points and then every 50000 points, the player earns an extra life.

448658.overview:
One of the many games called Rescue for C64, this one was published as a type-in game in a book "Commodore 64 Fun and Games".  The goal is to pilot a shuttle to rescue survivors from a crashed ship on an alien planet. The mothership cannot land, so players must ferry survivors back one at a time, contending with increasingly hostile alien forces. Survivors are found in groups of five, and as more are rescued, alien attacks intensify.

The game features three difficulty levels. On easy, players start with five shuttles and face one row of alien attackers, gaining bonuses for rescuing full groups. Higher difficulties reduce the number of shuttles and increase alien rows and hazards, such as permanent space flak and smaller landing pads.

Controlled with a joystick, missions start with 3000 gallons of fuel. Points are earned for each rescue, with more points awarded on higher difficulties. The game ends when shuttles are exhausted or the mother ship runs out of fuel.

448659.overview:
Rescue! is an action game where players travel across the galaxy to save malfunctioning humanoids. Set in a future where humans have expanded their technological reach, players take on the role of a top-ranking space pilot tasked with rescuing humanoids from planets and moons impacted by a security breach. 

The gameplay involves using a joystick to control the spaceship's thrust in various directions, requiring precise timing and coordination. The game features multiple levels of increasing difficulty and offers rewards for successful missions.

448666.overview: A miscellaneous action game for the Commodore 64. It was developed by Fanfare House and published by CBS College Publishing as a type-in game in the book "Arcade Games for the Commodore 64" in 1985.

449784.overview:
A terrorist ring leader has captured a National Park, and has sent his hench people to drop mines into the river. He is plotting to destroy a dam which  is there to protect neighbouring villages from being flooded. What used to be a large beautiful natural tourist attraction has been transformed into a deadly war zone.  Sightings of the leader has been spotted inside a blue plane - heading towards the dam. He must be stopped!

Your mission is to guide your boat through the National Park and find the terrorist ring leader's plane. You will not be alone because you will have to fight his hench army with your own firepower. The enemy forces are based on ground, air and water. Some enemies will require more than one hit before they are destroyed. Some other  enemies will target your boat before engaging fire. 

During your travel, you will encounter various obstacles. Some of which must be  avoided, and others which can be shot. These include mines. Floating mines can be shot, the underwater mines dropped by grey military boats cannot be shot. You should avoid running your boat onto the mines, otherwise a life will be lost. Other deadly obstacles, which can be shot include bridges and hungry crocodiles. Mind you, we would not want one of those reptiles to clamber on board your boat do we?

Rescue swimmers who are stuck in the water. For every swimmer rescued, you will be awarded 1,000 points. Pick up life rings for 2,000 points. The higher the score, the closer you are to being awarded an extra life. Extra lives are awarded for every 10,000 points reached. Unless of course, you already have 9 lives in the lives counter.

Can you help save the dam (and its neighbouring villages) from being destroyed before it is too late?

Good luck agents!

This is also the first horizontal scrolling SEUCK game to scroll from left to right, as opposed to from right to left.

454824.overview: This is a roguelite game for Commodore 64. There are currently 20 randomly generated levels waiting for you full of monsters and treasure.

455171.overview:
Rise and Shine Professor Miggles for the C64 is an unofficial conversion of a PICO-8 game of the same name.

It was developed by Paul "Zep" Koller (Super Bread Box, Spelunky 64, LuftrauserZ, etc.) and released as part of the 2016 C64 4KB Game Coding Competition.

455687.overview:
Rust'n'Steel is a multi-screen (not scrolling) platform game for the Commodore 64.

It was developed and released by Construction Computer Players in 2015.

456886.overview:
The New Dimension is very proud to present a mind bending light and sound hi score challenge, written specially for the Simon Game Basic Jam, organised by Retro Programmers Inside and Phaze 101. This game is a BASIC programmed production, with some additional machine code enhancements, such as use of interrupts, fast screen display, etc and of course some awesome spaced out disco music on the title screen. 

INSTRUCTIONS

On the title screen press one of the function keys to select the game skill level. The game skill level is based on the speed of the game.

This game requires a joystick in port 2 (or emulated as joystick in port 2). Repetition 64 is a mind bending game of light and sound.

The joystick controls represent the following colour:

UP = Red

DOWN = Yellow

LEFT = Green

RIGHT = Blue

When the blank screen appears, this indicates that the game is being set up. Once ready, it is time to play the game.

You are presented with the game screen with four lights. The computer will first play a sequence of lights, along with corresponding musical chords. After the computer has played its sequence, it is then your turn to repeat the sequence.

For every correct light selected, you will score 150 points.

For every complete sequence, you will score a bonus of 1,000 points. You will then move on to the next level which plays adds one extra colour and chord to the sequence.

For every 8 levels completed you will be awarded one extra life as well as the usual 1,000 points bonus.

If you select an incorrect light, you will lose a life. After all lives are lost, the game is over.

This game is a hi score challenge, so keep on scoring as many points as you can before you lose the game. 

How far can you get before this game really plays havoc with your mind?

Good luck. You will need it.

457399.overview:
ROGUEish is a rogue-like for the C64 computer (either via emulation or on real Hardware). 
It was inspired by "Rogue 64" (a c64 game), "RogueCraft" (an Amiga game), and to some extent, Marvel Avengers Alliance (an online game that is now dead).

457427.overview: A very rare promo edition of Rock Star Ate My Hamster on the Commodore 64 has been recovered.

459384.overview: This is a fast-paced game for two players. Each player controls a robot.

459428.overview: Our objective is to absorb the spirit of all the Sentinels that appear throughout the 10 sacred temples. Each temple consists of 3 screens that share the same stage but differ in the configuration of their platforms. Each Sentinel has a unique color, and must be captured in a specific order.

459574.developer: The waterloo country board of education
459574.publisher: The waterloo country board of education

459733.overview:
Rockfall is an unofficial English fan translation of the 1986 German language game 
Steinschlag. The translation was done by the scene group, Antarctica and  was released into the public domain on December 15, 2012.

461106.overview: Land the spaceship on the platform

462254.overview:
Ranma ½ is a manga written and illustrated by Rumiko Takahashi that tells the story of the adventures and adventures of its protagonist, Ranma Saotome, and the characters who accompany him. Martial arts and the Saotome and Tendo families form the backdrop for the various stories, including the succession and continuity of the Tendo Dojo, which is the reason the two families unite through the engagement of our protagonist and Akane Tendo.

The story revolves around two families, the Saotome and the Tendo, both experts in martial arts. What makes this manga unique are the different curses that befall the characters after they fall into the enchanted springs of Jusenkyo. The first are Genma Saotome and his son Ranma, who, during training in these springs, fall into two of them. Genma falls into the Spring of the Drowned Panda, while Ranma falls into the Spring of the Drowned Red-Haired Girl. The curse transforms them into the deceased being in the spring when they come into contact with cold water and returns them to their original state with hot water.

The game:



In this game, we must guide our protagonist through four trials and prove our commitment to Akane. To prevent this, we'll encounter Shampoo, Ukyu Kuonji, P-Chan, and Ryoga Hibiki, who will try to catch us and transform us into a girl. If they do, we must return to the start screen to transform back into a boy and continue our mission. We have a total of three lives to complete our mission.

463877.overview: Rally dei Faraoni is an Italian-language 1-player car racing game for the Commodore 64. It was developed by Marco Mietta & Luca Tassam and published in Next Game #09 (06/1986).

463880.overview:
Raptor is a 1-player vertically scrolling shooter developed by Silvio Frattini using the Shoot 'Em Up Construction Kit, and released as part of the following:

- Commodore 64 Club #06 [Italian Release]
- Commodore Computer Club Nr.5

463890.overview: A single-player vertically scrolling run and gun developed by Marco Mietta  using the Shoot 'Em Up Construction Kit and published by Systems Editoriale in 1990.

464296.overview: Road to the World Cup is a ritualized football experience for the Commodore 64, where every play is a narrative decision. It's not just about winning: it's about advancing, resisting, and celebrating every moment as part of a living archive.

466889.overview:
Your father, the King of Babylon, has died unexpectedly, and you inherit his throne. Babylon is a burgeoning little settlement, and after your father gained dominance in the region through successful campaigns, his goal was to make Babylon the most powerful and influential city. 

His unexpected death prevents him from carrying out his plans himself.  Now it's up to you to make his dream a reality.

About
In Rise of Babylon, your goal is to achieve the greatest possible population growth in the city of Babylon during your reign. 

Since space and time are limited, skillful city planning is essential. As king, you will also have to make important decisions. Events and dangerous neighbors will complicate your task.

Requirements
This game was created for the Commodore 64. It can be played on real hardware, or in a C64 emulator like Vice. The complete game is controlled with a joystick. 

The game is compatible with both PAL and NTSC.

The game includes German, English, and Polish language versions.

Where to get it? 
You can download a digital version of the game and a manual here for free (see downloads below).

A physical version of the game will later be published by the magazine Komoda & Amiga plus.

470697.overview: Race 'N Smash is a small but fun vertical scrolling racing game, which was developed as part of the "Fun and Games Programming in Assembly" tutorial, run by Lemon 64.

471371.overview: Remember It is a 1-2 player (alternating turns) tile matching memory game for the Commodore 64. It was developed by D.J.B. Shibley and published in 1985 as part of Loadstar #008.

472098.overview: Experience the ultimate Arkanoid-reimagining on the Commodore 64! Featuring smooth parallax scrolling, 24 randomized stages, and a unique "Coffee Break" help system.

472474.overview: A game inspired by Tolkien’s trilogy, in which the player takes on the role of a hobbit named Frodo. The player’s task is to collect rings that appear at random throughout the land and carry them, one by one, back to the hobbit-hole. The entire realm consists of four screens, three of which are heavily guarded by Sauron’s minions. Frodo can use the power of the ring at any time, becoming invisible to his enemies for a moment. On the guarded levels, using this power is often essential to retrieve a ring. However, overusing it increases the ring’s hold over the little hobbit’s mind. The game ends when Frodo is caught by hostile creatures or when the ring takes control of his mind.

472807.overview: ROB-MAN is a ground-up Commodore 64 reconstruction of the arcade classic, written entirely in 100% Assembly, pushing the VIC-II chip to its absolute limits.

472890.overview: Whit your space ship save the astronauts

480489.overview:
Ruote Fumanti (smokin tyres) is a Commodore 64 game. A 24 KB program that runs on a stock PAL machine: a real C64, a flashcart, any emulator. No memory expansions. 
 
Eight stages, flat out

The traffic does not move over for you: you overtake it, you shunt it off the road, or you land on top of it. The fords cannot be driven around, they have to be jumped, and you need ninety-five miles an hour to leave the ground. Some stages have rock ravines instead of water, and if you go in the car shrinks away as it falls. The winter stages have ice.
Seven seconds with the police

In the last stretch of every stage the traffic clears out and a police car comes up behind you. One against one, with the jump disabled. You hold your line, or you push it off the road, which is the thing that pays best in the whole game.
On the panel

Score, miles per hour, cars left, hits, time. How much of the course you have done, as a percentage. And a JUMP OK light, on when you are going fast enough to take off. The readouts are sprites, so they never wobble with the scrolling.
